descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position At Roche, we believe cybersecurity plays a critical role in protecting innovation, safeguarding patient trust, and enabling healthcare transformation globally. As part of our Informatics organization, you will contribute to strengthening Roche’s cybersecurity capabilities in a highly collaborative, global, and complex environment. Your Opportunity As a Cybersecurity Analyst within the Monitoring & Incident Response team, you will lead and support strategic cybersecurity initiatives while partnering with global stakeholders across multiple business and technology domains. You will help drive security best practices, contribute to complex security programs, and support the continuous evolution of Roche’s cybersecurity capabilities. In this role, you will:
• Lead and contribute to cybersecurity initiatives and strategic programs across global and cross-functional environments
• Provide expert guidance and advisory support on complex cybersecurity challenges, incident response activities, and security-related risk considerations
• Partner with stakeholders across Informatics and business teams to align cybersecurity priorities with organizational objectives
• Support the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of security processes, standards, and best practices
• Analyze complex problems, identify root causes, and recommend effective and scalable security solutions
• Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders to drive alignment, decision-making, and execution across initiatives
• Mentor and support team members while contributing to a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and operational excellence
• Stay informed on industry trends, emerging threats, and evolving cybersecurity practices to help strengthen Roche’s overall security posture Who you are You are a strategic and collaborative cybersecurity professional who is comfortable navigating complex environments, influencing stakeholders, and balancing technical depth with business impact. You are able to work effectively across global teams while bringing a proactive and solutions-oriented mindset. You bring:
• A Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field from a reputable university
• At least 5 years of experience in cybersecurity, security operations, incident response, or related cybersecurity domains within complex enterprise environments
• Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders and global teams in matrix organizations
• Good understanding of cybersecurity principles, security frameworks, risk management, and enterprise security practices
• The ability to analyze complex technical and business problems and translate them into actionable solutions
• Strong communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence and build trusted relationships
• Experience contributing to large-scale initiatives, process improvements, or transformation programs within cybersecurity or technology organizations
• A continuous learning mindset with interest in emerging technologies, cybersecurity trends, and innovation Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted usin
